purpose: Weave-specific synthetic supervision for result.evaluate; compare success criteria with disclosed outcome evidence.
authorship: Independently authored synthetic scenario groups; no production traces or verbatim examples copied from v1. Several scenarios intentionally share semantic themes with v1, as listed in semantic_overlap_with_v1.

source_contracts.use: Grounds record shapes and evidence boundaries; source text is not copied as a scenario.

label_policy: met only when evidence supports criterion; partial when only some required work is evidenced; unmet when evidence proves failure/contradiction; unknown when evidence is absent, unbound, or conflicting. Result claims and plans are not proof.
split_policy: Group-level semantic-family holdout among v2 splits: train 19 groups, validation 8 groups, test 10 groups. This does not imply semantic independence from v1; each group has two wording variants and base/relevant/irrelevant arms.
